requirements.Title: Business Ink Tank Solution
requirements.Description: Develop HP's first business ink tank printer targeting the SMB segment with 5-250 employees, focusing on ROI, efficiency, and low total cost of ownership (TCO).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses a gap in HP's portfolio for CISS PLE Hi segment and competes with market trends toward CISS in SMBs.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, R&D Telemetry, BA, GXD, Quality, Supplies Quality, DVAR, Tech Reg, Prod Steward
requirements.Dependencies: CISS technology, business ink tank design, market research
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is launched as HP's first business ink tank printer, available to SMBs with 5-250 employees, and achieves targeted TCO benchmarks.

requirements.Title: AI Productivity & Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate AI-powered productivity features and scan workflow enhancements, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan, to simplify device management for non-IT users in SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT staff and require easy-to-manage solutions; differentiates HP from competitors with advanced AI features.
requirements.Dependencies: AI software development, device management portal integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI features (Perfect Print, Perfect Scan) are implemented and validated to improve productivity and manageability for non-IT users in SMBs.

requirements.Title: Consolidated SMB Device Management Portal
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for SMBs to manage their printers, targeting unmanaged or lightly managed businesses with no dedicated IT staff.
requirements.Rationale: Simplifies multi-device management for office managers/generalist IT in SMBs, a key pain point for the segment.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal software development, integration with printer firmware and AI features
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal is accessible to SMBs, supports management of multiple devices, and is validated in customer environments with positive feedback.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business TCO
requirements.Description: Design printer and supplies to deliver the lowest total cost of ownership in HP's business segment, including cost-efficient ink tanks and reduced maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: TCO is a top priority for SMBs; needed to compete with CISS offerings from competitors and drive adoption.
requirements.Stakeholders: Marketing, Supplies Quality, BA, Prod Steward
requirements.Dependencies: Ink tank design, supply chain, cost optimization
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO analysis demonstrates Magellan has the lowest business TCO compared to HP’s current portfolio and key competitors.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Implement a replaceable maintenance box that can be serviced by customers, with service center fallback if out of warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces downtime and service costs for SMBs without IT staff; meets new use-case requirements.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, R&D Telemetry, Supplies Quality, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware design, service documentation, warranty policy
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is user-replaceable under warranty; service center support is available out of warranty; validated in user testing.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Utilize keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure supply quality.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents user error and maintains print quality; supports sustainability and supply chain integrity.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink bottle design, supply chain integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are implemented and prevent incorrect usage in field testing.

requirements.Title: Sustainability – 60% Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer uses at least 60% recycled content plastic, exceeding competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses growing customer and regulatory demand for sustainable products; provides a competitive differentiator.
requirements.Stakeholders: Prod Steward, Tech Reg, Marketing, BA
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is verified to contain at least 60% RCP through supply chain and third-party audits.

requirements.Title: Warranty and Serviceability
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty of 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever comes first), with customer-replaceable parts and service center support post-warranty.
requirements.Rationale: Meets SMB expectations for reliability and ease of service; reduces service costs and downtime.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, R&D Telemetry, BA, Supplies Quality
requirements.Dependencies: Service policy, hardware design for replaceability
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are clearly communicated; customer-replaceable parts are available; service center support is operational post-warranty.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU: SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB Portal
requirements.Description: For non-PDL SKUs, support SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal, including PaaS support.
requirements.Rationale: Expands solution offerings for SMBs and supports platform-as-a-service (PaaS) business models.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKUs are compatible with SMB2.0 Solutions, Advanced View SMB portal, and PaaS.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU: Improved Speed and PDL/PS Support
requirements.Description: For PDL SKUs, achieve print speeds of 25/20 ppm (improved from 25/19), and ensure PDL/PS support and Blue Angel certification.
requirements.Rationale: Meets higher performance and compliance requirements for certain SMB customers; aligns with competitive benchmarks.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality, R&D Telemetry, Tech Reg, BA
requirements.Dependencies: Firmware development, hardware optimization, certification process
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKU achieves specified speeds, supports PDL/PS, and obtains Blue Angel certification.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable mobile printing capabilities and integration with the HP App for seamless printing from smartphones and tablets.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses the need for flexible, modern workflows in SMBs; meets customer expectations for mobile compatibility.
requirements.Dependencies: HP App development, mobile OS compatibility
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Mobile printing is functional and validated via the HP App on major platforms (iOS, Android).

requirements.Title: Telemetry and Analytics Requirements
requirements.Description: Implement telemetry features to collect device usage, health, and performance data for ongoing product improvement and proactive support.
requirements.Rationale: Enables HP and customers to monitor device health, optimize usage, and provide proactive support; supports PaaS.
requirements.Dependencies: Telemetry software, privacy compliance, analytics platform
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is collected, securely transmitted, and actionable insights are provided to HP and customers.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Platform as a Service) Enablement
requirements.Description: Ensure the printer platform supports HP's PaaS offerings for SMBs, including device management, analytics, and solution deployment.
requirements.Rationale: Supports HP’s strategic goal for PaaS acceleration and monetization in SMB segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is PaaS-ready and validated with HP’s PaaS solutions for SMBs.
